reviews.text: Brought my puppy Blaine in this morning for the first time and I’m so glad I did! Irma did a great job with his haircut. The staff is so nice and I look forward to making this our regular spot.
Took my miniature schnauzer for a schnauzer cut and it has been the cut yet! Loved it and will definitely be coming back.
Thank you!😊  …

They did an excellent job with my doodle's bath. He can be quite nervous with new people and with the groomer and vet but even though it was his first time here they put him right at ease. They took great care to brush out some small mats rather than cut everything out, and his fur was fluffy soft and beautiful afterwards. And he was a happy pup! Friendly staff and good availability for appointments. Will definitely be my new go to groomer in the area.
Thank you!🙏  …

lovely, friendly groomers, always excellent haircuts and washes on my dog! only loses one star because it takes around 4 hours drop off to pick up.

if you have the time to spare please check them out! i truly get the vibes that the people who work here really love and care for the animals they work with.
Thank you Martha for fitting me and Stormie into your schedule. You were professional, kind and made my 2 year old cockapoo look amazing. ❤️
Thank you!

This pet store is inflexible & over priced
Do not recommend

I'm new to the area and was looking for a new groomer for my dog and so happy I found this place! My dog came out smelling so good and nails were cut perfectly. He can be really anxious with groomers so I really appreciate them taking such good care of him!
Martha was very accommodating to our scheduling needs, and the dogs look fantastic.
They always do a great job and my dog loves it there!

I’ve been bringing my dog here for almost 2 years and the ladies here are incredible. My dog is typically scared of going to the groomer but I can tell how safe he feels as soon as we walk in here. His haircuts are always exactly as I want them! No complaints.

I brought my cat Marcus here to be groomed and when we got home I noticed that his paws were bleeding A LOT! I don’t know if they failed to notice that they HURT my boy while “grooming” him but also not mentioning it to me at all is very, very alarming. The respectful thing to do would have been to acknowledge the mistake, apologize, and make sure that I was aware of what was going on. So, either their staff are negligent or straight up cruel - neither are great qualities for working with animals. I’d feel awful if I harmed an animal while grooming them and would do what I could to make it right. The Paradise Pet Salon staff either don’t notice or care. I HIGHLY suggest you find another pet salon in the area to go to. I wouldn’t trust these people with my loved ones.
Thank you! So much!

I’ve taken my fluffy white cat here now twice and each time, she has had a purrfect haircut and no scratches or nicks! She has a lot of fur and can be quite difficult, but they’ve taken such good care of my kitty! I highly recommend for grooming! Thank you!
We have been bringing our large berniedoodle here for several years. Martha is amazing and kind.
This place is great! I come in with my dog regularly to get his nails trimmed and they always fit me in and take such good care of Little Brother.

This place did a great job with my dog, Finn! Similar to other reviews, he isn’t a huge fan of the groomer but they did a great job and had no complaints. I got the sense that the staff here truly does love animals, which is great.

We’ve hopped around to various local places but couldn’t find one we loved, until now!

Not a customer, just a bystander. Saw this pup panting in the window for 25 straight minutes (waiting for the bus). Doesn’t appear to have access to water (or toys or anything enriching). I went inside and waited in the lobby to ask if someone could get him water but no one would come to the front.
